collegeInfo: TISS Mumbai, established in 1936, is a premier social sciences institute in India offering programs in social work, development studies, public policy, human resources, health systems, and management. It is known for its strong research culture, social commitment, and extensive field engagement across India.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Awarded to students with exceptional academic performance in qualifying examinations or during the course.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Automatic evaluation based on academic records and entrance exam scores.

scholarships.amount: Partial or full tuition fee waiver
scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Available for students from economically weaker sections.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Students must submit financial documents for review by the TISS Financial Aid Committee.

events.eventFullDescription: TISS Mumbai holds an annual convocation ceremony to honor graduating students across all schools, with participation from faculty, students, and distinguished guests.
An annual lecture series organized in memory of Dr. Rajni Tilak, focusing on social sciences, development studies, and public policy.

infrastructure.infraDescription: The TISS Mumbai campus spans 21 acres in Deonar and includes modern classrooms, auditoriums, seminar halls, research centers, hostels, a central library, computer and analytics labs, sports facilities, and Wi-Fi enabled residential and academic spaces.
